nodes.label: Observation availability vs. missingness distinction
nodes.rationale: 'Absent' means no valid items or valid score were observed in the available analytical extract; it does not establish that a form was not administered. Outputs describe observation availability, not disease change and not causal missing-data mechanisms. This principle governs all availability/completeness indicators derived in this script.

nodes.label: No-causal-interpretation principle for observational associations
nodes.rationale: All adjusted/cross-domain regression models across block_B (script 21 Pop comparisons, script 22 cross-domain associations, script 24 transition profile models, script 25 longitudinal trajectory models) are explicitly documented as observational associations, not causal effects, and their interpretation strings enforce this at the row level.

nodes.label: Baseline-Pop circularity / regression-to-the-mean caveat
nodes.rationale: Baseline Pop is partly defined using baseline ESSDAI and ESSPRI, so ESSDAI/ESSPRI trajectories modeled against baseline-Pop group may partly reflect the group-definition process itself and regression to the mean rather than a true clinical trajectory difference.

nodes.label: Overlap-flag logic deduplication rationale
nodes.rationale: Extracted from 06_overlap_glandular_followup.py and 06_overlap_glandular_followup_base_1st_Visit.py, which previously carried this exact logic (constants + functions) as two byte-identical copies; both scripts now import from here so behavior is unchanged but duplication is eliminated.

nodes.label: PRO scoring migration-unchanged rationale
nodes.rationale: Formulas, item recoding, completeness rules, normative values, and PCS/MCS coefficients are migrated unchanged from 09_pros_baseline.py so that longitudinal scoring stays numerically identical to the original baseline algorithm; scores are computed independently per row and callers control visit selection.

nodes.label: Pipe-delimited conflicting-date retention rationale
nodes.rationale: The official clinical date for a source row is the minimum valid fragment in ids__visit_date. This deliberately retains rows with conflicting pipe-delimited dates so they can be audited rather than silently discarded.
